LEDFORD, MATTHEW WAYNE BUNCOMBE COUNTY TAX INFORMATION Property tax notices based on assessed property values as of January 2024 will be mailed in August 2024. Would you like to make multiple payments toward your next property tax bill instead of a single, larger payment? We offer structured payment arrangements and are happy to help you set one up. Call (828) 250- 4910 for more information. Property tax relief for the elderly and permanently disabled persons: Anyone wishing to apply for exclusion under NCGS 105-277.1 should contact the Exemption Division of the Buncombe County Assessment Department at (828) 250-4915. Disabled Veterans: Exclusion up to $45,000 of appraised value for honorable discharged veterans with permanent and 100% service-connected disability from the US Department of Veterans Affairs. There is no age or income limitation for this program. The benefit is also available to the surviving spouse, providing they have never remarried since the death of the qualifying veteran.
